summary: Comprehensive testing of Admin Sandbox Simulator feature. All 38 backend tests pass (22 sandbox + 2 original sandbox + 14 regression). Frontend UI testing successful after fixing a critical bug where sandbox.metrics was accessed before null check.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED - TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'playerCount') when sandbox exists but metrics is undefined

critical_code_review_comments: AdminSandboxSimulator.jsx line 181: Added defensive check for sandbox.metrics to prevent TypeError when sandbox object exists but metrics is undefined
test_credentials: None required - tests create fresh admin households via API
seed_data_creation: Tests create sandbox households dynamically via /api/sandbox-households endpoint
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin Sandbox Simulator feature fully tested. All sandbox CRUD operations, player perspective switching, task/event actions, schedule editing, notes, and mock endorsements work correctly. Regression tests for random events, availability calendar, and verification flows all pass.

sandbox_creation.details: Admin can create sandbox with 2-8 players, tasks auto-assigned, mock endorsements generated

aerial_dashboard.details: Shows all players with stats (pending chores, refused, missed, notes, events), metrics cards accurate

player_perspective_switching.details: Clicking player card loads perspective panel with tasks, events, schedule, notes

task_actions.details: Complete/Refuse/Miss buttons update correct player/task state and XP

event_actions.details: Accept/Dismiss/Complete update secret mission state and award XP

schedule_editing.details: 7-day schedule editor saves and refreshes sandbox state

notes.details: Admin can write notes as selected player, notes appear in activity feed

mock_endorsements.details: CastleBean Coffee, DragonFuel Grocers, QuestWash Laundry etc. render with claim buttons

manual_mission_trigger.details: Generate event button triggers mission for selected player

regression_random_events.details: Random event bubble and pair event completion still work

regression_availability_calendar.details: Weekly availability, date overrides, and availability-aware assignment intact

regression_verification_flows.details: Task verification, approval/rejection, and join flow redistribution work

mocked_apis_list: Mock business endorsements (McKingBurger, CastleBean Coffee, DragonFuel Grocers, QuestWash Laundry, Crown Cinema, TableTop Tavern) are intentionally MOCKED brand rewards for simulation mode
